reasons: Lake identity is verified for Scott v. Harris, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 2007-04-30, with expected_citation_found true and canonical_name_match true.
Lake citations include official 550 U.S. 372, parallels 127 S. Ct. 1769 and 167 L. Ed. 2d 686, and vendor-neutral 2007 U.S. LEXIS 4748.
Lake treatment lists field_i_validity as good_law with no point_overrides, so the disclosed currency record does not show the authority dead or displaced.
residual_risks: Treatment derivation lanes are capped and audit-flagged; this review is limited to disclosed files.

reasons: Lens B does not evaluate support or quote fidelity.
From a currency angle, the lake treatment field remains good_law and the scope_note preserves the Garner/Graham point stated in the holding.
No disclosed finalized point override, overruling, abrogation, or supersession is attached to this holding.
residual_risks: Any support or quote-fidelity issue is outside this lens.

reasons: Lens B does not independently grade the home-page taxonomy role.
Currency supports continued use as a key authority: the record is SCOTUS, good_law, and shows 2857 indexed citing opinions with citation_count 13453.
No disclosed finalized negative treatment defeats the case's live-law status for use-of-force purposes.
residual_risks: The separate Use of Force page is not in the disclosed file set; this verdict addresses only currency/treatment.

defect.locator_note: treatment field and Treatment & subsequent history wording
defect.problem: The core good_law treatment call is supported by the lake judgment fields, but the page's absolute negative-treatment phrasing should be qualified because the disclosed treatment derivation is audit-flagged and includes proposed negative-event candidates.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep field_i_validity as good_law, but change absolute wording such as "No negative treatment" to "No confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record" unless the R15 treatment audit is completed.

reasons: Lake treatment lists field_i_validity as good_law, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, varies_by_point false, and point_overrides as an empty array.
All 25 listed treatment edges have field_iii set to mentioned, so the disclosed edge records do not finalize an overruling or abrogation of Scott itself.

But the derivation also flags audit_needed/cap_hit lanes and lane2_top_cited has proposed_negative_events 25, so the unqualified 'No negative treatment' wording is stronger than the disclosed audit record supports.
residual_risks: A complete treatment audit is not disclosed; external confirmation is barred by the task instructions.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Qualify treatment prose to distinguish confirmed negative treatment from proposed/audit-needed candidates.

reasons: Lake identity lists court as U.S. Supreme Court, court_id scotus, and court_level scotus.
The content page authority_weight is Binding — SCOTUS, which matches the disclosed court identity.
No disclosed treatment field changes the binding-weight label; negative-treatment concerns, if any, go to validity rather than source hierarchy.
residual_risks: Binding force can vary by jurisdiction and issue framing, but the federal SCOTUS source label is correct from the disclosed record.
